chapters.title: Départ
chapters.subtitle: Comprendre l'examen et trouver ton niveau
chapters.goal: Know what the TCF Canada asks, set your target and measure your starting level.

chapters.title: Se présenter, comprendre l'essentiel
chapters.subtitle: Expression orale tâche 1 · documents du quotidien
chapters.goal: Talk about yourself with developed answers and catch key information in short documents.

chapters.title: Obtenir des informations
chapters.subtitle: Belleville · expression orale tâche 2 · messages
chapters.goal: Ask clear, polite questions on the phone and write short messages that answer every point.

chapters.title: Raconter
chapters.subtitle: Expression écrite tâche 2 · temps du passé
chapters.goal: Tell an experience in the past, comment on it and give advice, with accurate grammar.

chapters.title: Argumenter
chapters.subtitle: Expression orale tâche 3 · expression écrite tâche 3
chapters.goal: Defend an opinion with arguments and examples, and compare two viewpoints in writing.

chapters.title: Le Grand TCF
chapters.subtitle: Conditions réelles · 2 h 47
chapters.goal: Manage time and stamina over a complete exam, then check you're ready.

cefr_note: Each stage's CEFR label shows the difficulty it aims at. Your own level is measured separately and never awarded by the map.
